description: PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for South Korean public-procurement SUPPLIERS — "who supplies software to Korean government agencies", "Korean vendors with KONEPS contracts for office chairs in Sejong", "woman-owned or social-enterprise suppliers of CCTV". Searches vendor cards built from the Public Procurement Service's KONEPS shopping-mall contract items and the last 12 months of delivery records (data.go.kr 15129471 / 15129427), assembled by BOIM (boim.io). Filter by item category (조달청 물품분류 name or 8-digit code), category group, region (HQ, recent deliveries or declared service area), free text on the vendor name, and certification (여성기업, 사회적기업, 장애인기업, …). Ordering is relevance → completeness of the vendor card → daily rotation, NOT by volume. Returns each vendor with id (use korea_get_vendor), name, matched region basis, item categories, 12-month procurement record count and agency count, last delivery date, business status, and BOIM card URL. Vendor directory text is Korean.

category.description: Item name as the Public Procurement Service classifies it (e.g. 안내판, 복사용지, 사무용 의자, 노트북컴퓨터, 소화기, 철근) or an 8-digit 물품분류번호. korea_list_categories lists them.

cert.description: Certification or class, part of its name: 여성기업, 사회적기업, 장애인기업, 중소기업자간 경쟁제품.

group.description: Top-level item group, part of its name (e.g. 출판물, 건자재, 가구, 사무용기기, 공공안전및치안장비). korea_list_categories without arguments lists the groups.

query.description: Word in the vendor name or item name (Korean matched directly; common English item terms are mapped).

region.description: Region (province, city or district), e.g. 세종, 충청남도, 경기도 고양시 — or Sejong, Gyeonggi.
